features.title: Celery + Redis async task queue
acceptanceCriteria: celery[redis] and redis added to requirements.txt
backend/app/worker.py exists with Celery app + run_scraping_task

POST /api/jobs/{id}/run submits Celery task and returns task_id
GET /api/jobs/{id}/task-status returns Celery task state + progress
docker-compose.yml has redis and worker services
tests/test_worker.py has at least 5 tests covering task submission, retry, status query
All existing API endpoints still work unchanged
features.notes: Replace BackgroundTasks with Celery. Use fakeredis in tests. Worker runs as separate docker service.

features.title: Redis caching layer
acceptanceCriteria: backend/app/cache.py exists with get_cached_result and set_cached_result
